description: Writes a free, polite message asking the host or rental company for the evidence behind a damage charge, ready to paste. A general template, not written around a specific bill.

amount.description: Amount being asked for, if known

country.description: AU for Australia, US for the United States. Defaults to the site that was called

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, e.g. USD or AUD

platform.description: Who sent the bill, e.g. Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, Stayz, Hipcamp, Hertz, Sixt, Avis, Budget, Enterprise, Europcar, Turo, Zipcar, Outdoorsy, RVshare, Camplify, JUCY, Britz, Maui, a direct host

recipient_name.description: Who the message is to, e.g. the host or claims team, if known

your_name.description: The user's name, only if they gave it

name: draft_evidence_request
title: Draft an evidence request
